draft.overall: NXL leads into the last hour, up 68 percent from the prior close, after our sources found a definitive exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America. NAMM is up 51 percent and printed a new high of day since the previous checkpoint, with first-half results and an operating update found in our sources, and EJH is up 28 percent with an AI service robot launch paired with a private-placement agreement. Fresh news turned up in our sources for 6 of the 12 names the desk covers.

lines.text: Nexalin announced at 08:30 ET on October 1, 2026 a definitive 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement covering Brazil and South America, which the company framed as a move toward commercial revenue. The desk reads it as a company-specific commercialization story, though the release gives no contract value, minimum purchases or expected revenue.

The newest item in our sources is the September 3, 2026 retail launch of Perfecta plant-based meat in the Northeastern U.S., its first U.S. shelf placement, which is not a fresh catalyst. No sales, revenue or store count was disclosed, so the desk cannot size it.

Airship AI announced at 09:00 ET on October 1, 2026 $29.0M of firm-fixed-price brand-name-only awards from an agency within the Department of Homeland Security. The desk reads the award as material against recent quarterly revenue, though delivery and revenue-recognition timing are not stated.

The company's S-3 shelf covering up to $50.0M of stock, preferred and warrants became effective on September 30, 2026, which the desk reads as financing capacity only, with no takedown or sale documented. It is down 17.4% since the previous checkpoint, and nothing in our sources ties the shelf to the move.
Not researched yet: there is no dossier on file at this checkpoint.

The company disclosed at 17:51 ET on September 29, 2026 the completed sale of Altruis Benefit Consulting for $8 million in cash plus an earnout of up to $1 million, which is not a fresh catalyst. The desk reads it as cash that advances its monetization strategy, with the pro forma effect unquantified.

E-Home announced at 07:15 ET on October 1, 2026 an AI service robot for China's household-services market, alongside a September 29 private-placement agreement for 71.8 million shares at $0.60. The desk weighs the AI headline against that pending placement priced below the market, and the evidence does not show the placement has closed.

No fresh catalyst was found in our sources: the latest company event is Series A warrants at a $6.35 exercise price that became exercisable on September 18, 2026, after an August 26, 2026 enrollment update for ELAINE-3. The desk reads the filing as potential overhead rather than favorable news, and no exercises have been established.

Namib Minerals reported first-half 2026 results at 08:00 ET on October 1, revising production guidance to 26,500 to 27,000 ounces and reporting AISC of $3,078 per ounce, after a September 29 $6.5M non-dilutive term loan for Redwing restart work. The desk reads the guidance and cost figures as adverse and the loan as non-equity funding; it printed a new high of day since the previous checkpoint.

The latest item is the September 28, 2026 close of a public offering of 12,000,000 shares at $0.80 for about $9.6M, which is not a fresh catalyst. The desk reads it as new issuance and finds no separate positive event in our sources.

Foghorn reported at 03:01 ET on October 1, 2026 that it and Lilly will not advance FHD-909 past Phase 1 dose escalation or the SMARCA2 degrader program, and announced a workforce reduction of about 40%. The desk reads it as a major strategic retrenchment; it printed a new high of day since the previous checkpoint.
